python3 -c "
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

im2 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0002.png'))
# Lamp base in obs2:
# Cam pose at obs2: (0, 0, 90.0)
mask_base = (im2[:,:,0] < 100) & (im2[:,:,1] < 105) & (im2[:,:,2] < 115) & (im2[:,:,0] > 60)
coords = np.argwhere(mask_base)
coords = np.array([c for c in coords if c[0] > 400 and c[1] < 200])
print('Lamp base in obs2: min u:', coords[:,1].min(), 'max u:', coords[:,1].max())
print('Lamp base in obs2: min v:', coords[:,0].min(), 'max v:', coords[:,0].max())
bottom = coords[coords[:,0] == coords[:,0].max()]
print('Bottom contact u,v:', bottom[:,1].mean(), coords[:,0].max())
"
